messages:
maria: Quick sync — we need a concise launch-readiness checklist for the next GA tranche. Goal: clear tradeoffs between SLA scope, docs, support, monitoring, and pricing tiers. I can take consolidation but need owner signoffs.

alex: +1. Can we codify which SLA items are hard blockers vs negotiable? e.g., 99.9% availability for Hosted, but Dedicated customers may need 99.95%? :thinking_face: 

chris: From eng: availability target is doable for Hosted at 99.9 with current infra, 99.95 needs capacity bump + extra failover config. Also p95 latency SLO depends on model family + batching.

maria: Good — propose we split criteria into MUST/SHOULD/NICE. MUST = blocking for GA. SHOULD = default recommendation for early customers. NICE = stretch.

tina: For docs: MUST = quickstart + API reference + migration notes for existing customers. SHOULD = troubleshooting KB and runbook snippets. NICE = example apps showing canary config. I can own doc checklist.

raj: Pricing note: enterprise customers expect SLA tiers to map to committed spend. We should decide whether 99.95 is a billed add-on or tied to Dedicated only. Also need a clear billing escalation path if we credit customers.

lucy: Support: MUST = documented oncall rotation + escalation matrix. SHOULD = playbook for degraded-model fallbacks. NICE = 24/7 live support for top-tier. We can staff oncall but need handoff docs.

chris: Engineering ask: add a simple telemetry flag to capture per-request model variant + region for first 30 days of GA. This helps debugging and can be toggled. Impact: small perf overhead but worth it.

maria: Here's a first-pass compact checklist (will expand into a table). Please react with owner initials if you can take the line.

maria: ```
MUST:
- SLA: 99.9% availability for Hosted (prod), documented SLOs and credit policy
- Docs: Quickstart, API reference, migration guide
- Support: Oncall rota + escalation matrix, contact points for customers
- Monitoring: Token-level latency + per-route error metrics + alerting
- Pricing: published baseline tiers with clear SLA link

SHOULD:
- SLA: 99.95 option for Dedicated with explicit cost delta
- Docs: Troubleshooting KB, runbook snippets, SDK examples
- Support: Playbook for model fallback and severity routing
- Monitoring: Customer-facing dashboards (basic)
- Pricing: Add-on billing flow for SLA upgrades

NICE:
- SLA: Financial credits automation for incidents > threshold
- Docs: Example canary configs and traffic-shaping patterns
- Support: 24/7 live support for top-tier customers
- Monitoring: Per-tenant heatmaps, long-term retention for audits
```

alex: maria — I can own the SLA wording & credit policy, will draft legal-friendly text. alex:owner

chris: I can own the telemetry + monitoring bits. chris:owner

tina: Docs covered. tina:owner

raj: I'll model the pricing delta and churn impact. raj:owner

lucy: Support playbooks — lucy:owner. We need to agree RTO/RPO targets for each severity.

oncall-bot: Reminder: create incident-runbook template in #eng-oncall before GA (auto-reminder in 48h)

maria: Next steps: owners to drop a 3-line acceptance criterion on their lines by EOD tomorrow. Then we meet Fri 9am PT to lock the must-list. Is that doable?

alex: doable. I'll add the SLA text + credit matrix by EOD.

chris: Will prototype telemetry flag and a sample dashboard config by tomorrow afternoon.

tina: I'll start doc skeleton now, aiming for 1st draft by EOD.

raj: Will run pricing scenarios, I'll call out recommended default for Hosted versus Dedicated.

lucy: Drafting oncall + escalation doc now, will sync with ops for hours coverage.

maria: Awesome. One negotiation note: if we defer 99.95 for Hosted, we should commit to a clear roadmap and timeline so sales can set expectations. Put that in your acceptance line if applicable. :eyes: 

alex: noted. I'll add a timeline + gating conditions.

chris: small rollback risk: if telemetry flag causes perf degradation in peak, we'll toggle and notify. Will include fallback plan.

maria: Thanks everyone. I'll collate into a single page and ping for signoff before Fri. If anyone wants 1:1 to discuss tradeoffs, DM me. :thumbsup:
